name: Endless Parrying (Combat)
body:
You are able to parry as many attacks as you would normally be able to make.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, Quick Parry, parry class feature

Benefit: You can elect not to take any number of the attacks you would make using a full attack action, and instead reserve them to attempt to parry multiple attacks. You can only attempt to parry any given attack one time, and you can choose which attack that you have set aside to use for each parry attempt. (You do not need to use your best attack first.)

Normal: Normally you are only able to reserve one attack from each full attack action in order to make a parry attempt.
